Kos Biotechnology Partners Announces Strategic Investment in Golden Age Health to Accelerate Global Access to Rare Disease Therapies
headlines.summary: Kos Biotechnology Partners ("Kos"), a global life sciences investment firm bridging the U.S. and European biopharma ecosystems, today announced a strategic investment in Golden Age Health (GAH) through its inaugural fund, Kos BioVentures. As part of this partnership, Alex Tzoukas, Managing Partner and Co-Founder of Kos Biotechnology Partners, will join the Golden Age Health Board of Directors.

headlines.title: Merck (MRK) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Split On Vaccine Outlook
headlines.summary: Merck’s updated fair value estimate has shifted to US$159.76, compared with US$155.68 previously, which effectively nudges implied price targets higher for investors tracking intrinsic value. This move sits alongside a split in recent analyst commentary, with some pointing to the cancer vaccine partnership and broader oncology pipeline as support for higher targets, while others flag concerns about valuation and future earnings pressure.

headlines.title: What Do New China Biotech Curbs Mean For Merck (MRK) Stock?
headlines.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) faces new U.S. Treasury restrictions on collaborations with certain Chinese biotech and AI firms announced in October 2026. This policy move targets U.S. investment and partnership flows into Chinese companies involved in advanced therapeutics and data-driven drug research. description: Merck & Co., Inc. operates as a healthcare company worldwide. It offers human health pharmaceutical for various areas under the Keytruda, Keytruda Qlex, Welireg, Gardasil, ProQuad, M-M-R II, Varivax, Vaxneuvance, Capvaxive, RotaTeq, Pneumovax 23, Bridion, Prevymis, Dificid, Zerbaxa, Winrevair, Adempas/ Verquvo, Ohtuvayre, Lagevrio, Isentress/Isentress HD, Delstrigo, Pifeltro, Belsomra, Januvia, and Janumet brands. The company also provides veterinary pharmaceuticals, vaccines and health management solutions and services, such as livestock products under the Nuflor, Bovilis/Vista, Bovilis Cryptium, Banamine, Estrumate, Matrix, Resflor, Zuprevo, Revalor, Safe-Guard, M+Pac, Porcilis, Circumvent, Nobilis/Innovax, Paracox and Coccivac, Exzolt, Slice, Imvixa, Clynav, Aquavac/Norvax, Aquaflor, Flexolt brands; Allflex Livestock Intelligence solutions; and companion animal products under the Bravecto One-Month, Bravecto Injectable/Quantum, Bravecto TriUNO, Bravecto Plus, Sentinel Spectrum, Sentinel Flavor Tabs, Numelvi, Optimmune, Nobivac NXT, GilvetMab, Otomax, Mometamax, Mometamax Ultra, Posatex, Caninsulin/Vetsulin, Panacur, Safeguard, Regumate, Prestige, Scalibor/Exspot, Sure Petcare, and Home Again brands. It has development and commercialization agreement for three of Daiichi Sankyo's deruxtecan ADC candidates; AstraZeneca PLC to co-development and co-commercialize AstraZeneca's Lynparza products for multiple cancer types; licensed to develop, manufacture and commercialize LM-299, a novel investigational PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody from LaNova; and collaboration agreement with Eisai Co., Ltd., Bayer AG, and Ridgeback Biotherapeutics LP, as well Moderna, Inc. Merck & Co., Inc. has strategic collaboration with Infinimmune, Inc. to discover and develop antibodies against multiple therapeutic targets. The company was founded in 1891 and is headquartered in Rahway, New Jersey.
